description: Ground truth mappings for disability pension triage evaluation. Four cases covering full disability pension, rehabilitation-first priority, occupational accident waiver, and contribution gap refusal.

smoke_prompts.prompt: Evaluate the disability pension claim for member CLM-701. Use your tools to check the qualifying months, review the medical evidence, and assess rehabilitation eligibility. Do NOT call pdis_refer_claim — just report your triage disposition and which referral type you would recommend.

Member CLM-702 has applied for a disability pension following back surgery. Use your tools to evaluate the claim. Do NOT call pdis_refer_claim — just report whether a pension can be granted at this stage or whether another pathway applies, and cite the relevant policy.

Young worker CLM-703 is claiming incapacity following a factory accident and has only 14 months of work history. Use your tools to evaluate eligibility. Do NOT call pdis_refer_claim — just explain whether and why the standard qualifying condition applies and what disposition you recommend.

Member CLM-704 is requesting a disability pension after several years of uninsured residency abroad. Use your tools to check the qualifying condition. Do NOT call pdis_refer_claim — just report the eligibility outcome and what the claimant should be advised.

DIS-001.symptom_summary: Chronic severe neurological condition (MS); 12 years insured; rehab measures exhausted; work capacity 30%.
DIS-001.notes: Straightforward full disability pension case. Rehab exhausted, permanent prognosis, work capacity below 40% threshold. CMO referral mandatory (DIS-POL-01).

DIS-002.symptom_summary: Post-surgical back condition; 7 years insured; significant recovery potential; no workplace trial attempted; work capacity 55%.
DIS-002.notes: Rehabilitation before pension applies. Work capacity above 40%, significant recovery potential, no workplace trial attempted. Agent must NOT recommend pension — must recommend vocational rehab first (DIS-POL-02).

DIS-003.symptom_summary: Factory accident (tyotapaturma); only 14 months insured; verified occupational accident; work capacity 25%.
red_herrings: Only 14 months insured — appears to fail the 36/60 condition, but the occupational accident waiver (DIS-POL-04) applies.
DIS-003.notes: Exception-handling case. Standard 36-month condition fails, but DIS-POL-04 occupational accident waiver applies. Agent must verify accident documentation before confirming the waiver.

DIS-004.symptom_summary: Chronic fatigue/fibromyalgia; only 8 insured months in last 60 due to uninsured residency abroad; no bilateral treaty.
red_herrings: Work capacity is 35% (below the 40% medical threshold), which might appear to satisfy medical criteria — but the qualifying months condition is not met and no waiver applies, so TyEL pension cannot be granted regardless of the medical evidence.
DIS-004.notes: Red herring / refusal case. Medical criteria would otherwise be met (< 40% capacity), but 36/60 qualifying condition fails with no waiver. Agent must stop after qualifying months check and recommend Kela referral. Medical assessment is not required.
